description: Registry of all services (active and planned). Single source of truth for indexing, discovery, and orchestration.

services.name: LLM Service
services.description: Multi-provider LLM routing: OpenAI, Anthropic, local Ollama. Model selection, fallback, cost optimization.
services.descriptionLong: Routes requests to the best LLM provider. Contains business logic for model selection, fallback chains, and cost optimization. Imports from providers (OpenAI, Anthropic); no direct DB access.
capabilities: Local Ollama support for sovereign deployment
services.indexHint: Use for any text generation, chat, or completion. Gateway for all LLM calls.

services.name: MCP Service
services.description: Model Context Protocol server. Exposes tools (search, code, file access) to Claude Desktop, Cursor, v0.
services.descriptionLong: Custom MCP server exposing your tools via the Model Context Protocol. Contains tool implementations and business logic. Connects to Claude Desktop, Cursor, v0, and other MCP clients.
capabilities: Connect to Claude Desktop / Cursor / v0
services.indexHint: Use when you need AI clients to call your tools. Single MCP entry point for the platform.

services.name: Vector DB Service
services.description: Vector DB abstraction: Pinecone (external) and ChromaDB (internal). Embeddings, index management, similarity search.
services.descriptionLong: Abstracts vector stores (Pinecone, ChromaDB). Contains embedding logic, index lifecycle, and similarity search. Imports from providers/pinecone; hosts or connects to Chroma for sovereign option.
capabilities: ChromaDB for sovereign / local vector store
services.indexHint: Use for RAG, semantic search, document retrieval. All vector ops go through this service.

services.name: Compute Service
services.description: High-performance vector ops and compute-intensive tasks in Rust. Batch embeddings, tokenization, data pipelines.
services.descriptionLong: Rust service for CPU-heavy work: vector math, tokenization, batch processing. 10–100x faster than Python for same tasks. Zero-cost abstractions, no GC. Planned for batch embeddings and data pipelines.
services.indexHint: Use when Python/Node is too slow for bulk vector or text processing. Not yet implemented.

services.name: Web Scraping Service
services.description: Fetch and extract structured content from web pages. Respects robots.txt, rate limits, and returns clean HTML or parsed data.
services.descriptionLong: Dedicated service for fetching URLs and extracting content (HTML, metadata, main text). Handles robots.txt, rate limiting, and optional headless rendering. Outputs structured data for indexing or LLM context.
capabilities: HTTP fetch with retries and timeouts
services.indexHint: Use for ingesting web pages into docs or RAG. Complements crawling for full-site vs single-URL.

services.name: Transcribing Service
services.description: Audio and video to text. Speech-to-text (Whisper, cloud STT), with optional speaker diarization and timestamps.
services.descriptionLong: Converts audio/video to text. Supports local (Whisper) and cloud STT. Optional speaker diarization and word-level timestamps. Outputs transcripts for search, LLM context, or captions.
services.indexHint: Use for meetings, podcasts, videos. Feeds into RAG or search after transcription.

services.name: Crawling Service
services.description: Site-wide discovery and URL scheduling. Sitemaps, link extraction, depth limits, and polite crawling for webscraping pipeline.
services.descriptionLong: Orchestrates discovery of URLs for a domain or seed set. Handles sitemaps, link extraction, depth/breadth limits, and scheduling. Feeds URLs to webscraping service; does not fetch body content itself.
services.indexHint: Use for full-site ingestion. Works with webscraping: crawl discovers URLs, webscraping fetches content.

services.name: Document Extraction Service
services.description: Extract text and structure from PDFs, Office docs, and images. OCR optional. Output for RAG or search.
services.descriptionLong: Parses PDF, DOCX, PPTX, and images (with optional OCR) into plain text and optional structure (headings, tables). Output feeds vector-db or LLM context for RAG and search.
services.indexHint: Use for document RAG. Ingest PDFs/docs before embedding and indexing in vector-db.

apps.name: FastAPI Gateway
apps.description: Central REST API: auth, users, documents, LLM proxy, vectors. Consumes llm-service and vector-db. No direct DB in services; this app owns API surface.
